name: V1.1
body:
## Changes

### General
- Removed the empty `## Dependencies:` and `## OptionalDeps:` entries from the `.toc` file to prevent the client from reporting missing dependencies.

### Relationships Dashboard

#### Buff & Enchant Support
- Improved enchant detection to recognize additional Turtle WoW / OctoWoW enchant descriptions, including:
  - `+X Spell Damage and Healing`
  - `+X to Healing Spells`
  - `+X to Healing`
  - `Damage Bonus: X` (Sharpening Stones & Weightstones)

- Expanded world buff parsing to correctly recognize bonuses from:
  - Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer
  - Warchief's Blessing
  - Songflower Serenade
  - Dire Maul Tribute (DMT) buffs
  - Generic spell damage/healing bonus effects (`Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to X`)

- Improved Spell Power and Healing Power fallbacks so these values are displayed correctly even when Turtle WoW's `GetSpellBonusDamage()` or `GetSpellBonusHealing()` APIs do not return data.

### Notes
- No changes were required for player stat calculations. The player panel already uses Blizzard APIs (`UnitStat`, `UnitAttackPower`, `UnitDamage`, `UnitArmor`, `GetSpellBonusDamage`, etc.), which automatically include buffs, world buffs, and enchants. or GetSpellBonusHealing() APIs do not return data.
